name: empathy
quote: I think I know what you're feeling.
description: Ability to recognize and perhaps share the experience of a person or animal.

commentaries.quote: Empathy is the basic capacity to put yourself in the shoes of another. A person without this capacity may have trouble relating to people.
Exploring another's experience does not necessarily mean you have to agree with their outlook. It can result in many reactions ranging from compassion to manipulation.

conditions: A desire to better understand the perspective another, perhaps to help them or perhaps to help yourself.
